tools.name: create_persona
tools.description: Create a new AI persona with avatar, voice, language, and niche prompt. avatarUrl is REQUIRED: every persona has a face. A video without a face is a per-video choice — set options.faceless on generate_persona_video.

avatarUrl.description: REQUIRED. Public URL to the persona avatar image (use list_faces for stock face URLs). Every persona has a face; "no face" is chosen per video with generate_persona_video options.faceless.

language.description: Language code — English only for now (e.g. en-US, en-GB)

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material: "standard" fills the frame with the avatar, "react" splits it in half (persona on top, video material below: real clips or drawings). Same render cost either way.

scriptPrompt.description: System prompt instructions for video scripts

faceQuality.description: Face resolution of the rendered videos: ok (480p, 2 tokens/video) or very_good (720p, 3 tokens/video)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

images.description: Up to 10 local image files of the same person for the persona image library. Each video deterministically picks the best-matching image by tag.

imagePrimaryIndex.description: Index into images[] marking the primary library image (no primary is set when omitted)

tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List all existing personas for the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List persona voices (voiceId options): 65 English house voices, each with a text description of how it sounds plus gender/accent/kind, and your ready clones. Filter with gender, origin and search (e.g. "deep calm").

origin.description: us = American English, gb = British English, character = character voices

search.description: Words to match in the voice name or description, e.g. "deep calm", "pirate", "british warm"

tools.name: list_cloned_voices
tools.description: List per-user Chatterbox voice clones (status, voice_id when ready).

tools.name: create_cloned_voice
tools.description: Register a voice clone from a short HTTPS audio URL (requires explicit consent).

audioUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a short reference recording (MP3, WAV, M4A, or WebM, max 20MB)

language.description: Language code for the clone — English only for now (e.g. en, en-us)

consent.description: Must be true: caller confirms consent to voice cloning

denoise.description: Clean background noise from the recording before cloning (recommended true; false for studio audio)

tools.name: get_cloned_voice
tools.description: Get one voice clone by id: its status (poll after create_cloned_voice until ready or failed) and voice_id once ready.

cloneId.description: Cloned voice id (the id returned by create_cloned_voice or list_cloned_voices)

tools.name: delete_cloned_voice
tools.description: Delete one of your voice clones by id.

tools.name: preview_cloned_voice
tools.description: Synthesize a short MP3 preview for a ready voice clone, optionally speaking your own text (returns base64 audio; 10 previews per day).

language.description: Optional preview language override — English only for now

text.description: Optional words for the clone to speak (1-300 chars, English). Omit to hear the fixed sample. Previews are free and limited to 10 per user per day.

tools.name: list_faces
tools.description: List default/stock persona faces (avatar options). Each face includes id, url, name, gender, age (single number, not a range), ethnicity, hair, and description in English so you can pick without seeing the photo. Pass a face url as avatarUrl when calling create_persona.

tools.name: update_persona
tools.description: Update an existing AI persona (only the provided fields change).

personaId.description: The ID of the persona to update

language.description: New language code — English only for now (e.g. en-US, en-GB)

scriptPrompt.description: New system prompt instructions for video scripts

tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.description: List connected social accounts (YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, Bluesky) with the account IDs needed for posting.

tools.name: get_persona_publishing_accounts
tools.description: List a persona's default publishing accounts per provider. generate_persona_video falls back to these when no account IDs are passed; explicit IDs always win.

personaId.description: The persona ID whose default publishing accounts to list.

tools.name: set_persona_publishing_accounts
tools.description: Replace a persona's default publishing accounts (per provider). Account IDs come from list_social_accounts. Providers mapped to empty arrays keep no defaults.

personaId.description: The persona ID whose default publishing accounts to replace.

accounts.description: Default publishing accounts per provider, e.g. { youtube: ["UC..."], bluesky: ["did:plc:..."] }. Replaces the whole set: providers mapped to [] (or omitted) keep no defaults. Account IDs come from list_social_accounts (channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did).

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Connect a social account. For youtube/instagram/linkedin: returns an authorization URL — the user must open it in a browser and authorize, then the account connects automatically (verify with list_social_accounts). For bluesky: connects directly with handle + appPassword (app password, not the main account password).

handle.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. user.bsky.social). Required only for bluesky.

appPassword.description: Bluesky app password (Settings > App passwords). Required only for bluesky. Never shared or logged.

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List all automation schedules for the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List upcoming (scheduled) and past (published/failed) posts across all connected accounts. Returns two lists: upcoming slots and recent results, each with id, slot_at, status (awaiting|generating|ready|publishing|published|failed), title, schedule_id, task_id, progress (0-100: 0 for awaiting, 100 for ready/publishing/published, live engine progress for generating, last known for failed), stage (engine pipeline stage like "lipsync" while generating, "done" when complete, null otherwise), queuePosition/queueTotal (1-based position among the schedule's awaiting+generating slots; awaiting slots only, null otherwise). Failed slots also carry error and retryable (boolean: true when the failure looks transient). Use when the user asks about their posts — what is coming next, what already went out, how far a video has generated, where it sits in the queue, or why a post failed. Combine with list_schedules or list_social_accounts when persona/account names are needed.

limit.description: Max number of upcoming and past posts to return (each list). Default 20, max 500.

tools.name: cancel_schedule
tools.description: Cancel (delete) an automation schedule by its schedule ID. Unpublished slots (pending, generating, or ready) are removed so they cannot publish, and their prepaid tokens are refunded. A post already publishing or already published is not recalled. Use list_schedules to find the ID.

scheduleId.description: The ID of the schedule to cancel. Unpublished slots (pending, generating, or ready) are removed and their prepaid tokens are refunded. A post already publishing or published is not recalled.

tools.name: get_slot
tools.description: Get one scheduled post's full detail by slot ID: status, title, scheduled time, generation progress, its schedule (providers, publish mode) and persona. Use the slotId from list_posts.

slotId.description: The slot ID (the slotId field from list_posts or generate_persona_video).

tools.name: update_slot_title
tools.description: Edit the title text of one scheduled post. Only a slot that has not started generating (status pending/awaiting) can be edited — published or mid-flight slots are rejected.

slotId.description: The slot ID (the slotId field from list_posts or generate_persona_video).

title.description: The new title text for the slot. Only a slot that has not started generating (status pending/awaiting) can be edited; published or mid-flight slots are rejected.

tools.name: delete_slot
tools.description: Delete one scheduled post slot. Only pending (awaiting) or failed slots can be deleted; published or mid-flight slots are rejected. The schedule's last slot cannot be deleted — use cancel_schedule to delete the whole schedule instead.

slotId.description: The slot ID to delete. Only pending (awaiting) or failed slots can be deleted; published or mid-flight slots are rejected. The schedule's last slot cannot be deleted — delete the whole schedule with cancel_schedule instead.

tools.name: list_video_generations
tools.description: List the video generation history (newest first): one row per generated video with status, error code, token refund flag, and timestamps. Use get_video_generation for one row's detail.

limit.description: Max generations to return (1-200). Defaults to 50, newest first.

tools.name: get_video_generation
tools.description: Get one video generation's detail by generation ID (the generationId field from list_video_generations).

generationId.description: The generation ID (the generationId field from list_video_generations).

tools.name: cancel_video_task
tools.description: Cancel/remove one of your video tasks on the generation engine by task id (from get_video_status, get_video_task_progress, get_post or list_posts). Only the caller's own task can be cancelled; a persona-scoped API key can only cancel tasks belonging to its personas. Unknown or already-finished tasks return an error. No token refund is issued by this call.

taskId.description: Engine task id of the video to cancel (taskId from get_video_status, get_video_task_progress, get_post or list_posts). Only your own task can be cancelled.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get one post's full detail by id, whichever kind it is: a scheduled slot (kind "slot") or a direct video generation (kind "generation"). The server resolves the id, so there is no need to guess between get_slot and get_video_generation. Both kinds carry live generation progress while the video is still generating.

id.description: A post id of either kind: a slot id (slotId from list_posts / generate_persona_video) or a generation id (generationId from list_video_generations). The server resolves which one it is.

tools.name: get_post_metrics
tools.description: Get per-video performance snapshots (views, likes, comments, saves) of published posts for one window (24h or 7d), newest first, optionally filtered by persona, account, provider (network) and script angle. Returns rows plus truncated (true when more rows exist than the server cap).

window.description: Snapshot window: 24h (first day after publishing) or 7d (first week).

persona.description: Optional persona id filter (uuid from list_personas), or ^@none for posts with no persona.

account.description: Optional publishing account id filter (the account ids from list_social_accounts).

angle.description: Optional script angle filter (exact match), or ^@none for posts with no angle.

tools.name: list_token_transactions
tools.description: List the token ledger: every token credit and debit (purchases, generation spends, refunds), newest first, with amounts, reasons, and the related generation when there is one. Use to audit where tokens went.

limit.description: Max transactions to return (1-100). Defaults to 20, newest first.

offset.description: How many newest transactions to skip for paging. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_persona_delete_preview
tools.description: Preview what deleting a persona would remove: counts of schedules, upcoming/published/failed slots, generated videos and library images, plus per-video download links (read-only, never mutates). Call before delete_persona.

personaId.description: The persona ID to preview deletion for. Read-only: shows what deleting the persona would remove (counts plus per-video download links).

tools.name: delete_persona
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible: delete a persona with all its schedules, slots, generated videos, and image library. No token refunds — prepaid tokens for pending slots are forfeited. Call get_persona_delete_preview first.

personaId.description: The persona ID to delete. DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible: deletes the persona, all its schedules and slots, all generated videos, and the image library. No token refunds — prepaid tokens for pending slots are forfeited. Call get_persona_delete_preview first to see exactly what will be removed.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect a social account by provider and account ID (the IDs from list_social_accounts). The account stops being available for publishing.

provider.description: The social platform of the account to disconnect.

providerAccountId.description: The account ID on that provider (the channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did field from list_social_accounts).

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get the prepaid token wallet balance. Check before triggering video generation, which costs tokens.

tools.name: generate_persona_video
tools.description: Generate and schedule ONE persona video from a complete script. Product rule: generation is always tied to publishing — one call generates the video AND schedules its automatic publish; there is no orphan generation. Send the full script as segments (first hook, then body, last CTA; 60-200 words total, body at least 30, CTA 5-20, hook 15-40 words ending with terminal punctuation) — no LLM expands it. title is the slot label for this video. Pass providers plus per-provider account IDs (see list_social_accounts), startAt (ISO datetime, wall-clock in timezone when naive), times (HH:MM, 24h), and timezone. Set mode to 'asap' to publish the video the moment its generation finishes instead of scheduling it — startAt and times must NOT be set then. The slot must be 3h-30d ahead. idempotencyKey is generated automatically; reuse it to retry without generating twice (replayed: true). Poll the slot's taskId with get_video_task_progress.

personaId.description: The persona to generate the video with. Omit for a faceless post with no persona: in that case set options.faceless and options.voiceId (or options.audioUrl).

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, body in the middle, CTA last. Exactly one hook and one CTA.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

media.description: Phase 2: media reference, exactly one of mediaId (from upload_media) or url (a public image URL).

terms.description: Stock terms for this segment, chosen by the agent. At most 10.

segments.description: The complete script as segments: first hook, then body segments, last CTA. Total 60-200 words, body at least 30, CTA 5-20, hook 15-40 words before TTS. The hook must end with terminal punctuation. No LLM expands this script.

title.description: Video title: the slot label sent to the web route (one call is one video).

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US.

youtubeAccountIds.description: YouTube channel IDs (the channelId field from list_social_accounts).

instagramAccountIds.description: Instagram account IDs (the igUserId field from list_social_accounts).

linkedinAccountIds.description: LinkedIn account IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

blueskyAccountIds.description: Bluesky DIDs (the did field from list_social_accounts).

mode.description: Publish mode: 'scheduled' (default) slots the video across startAt + times; 'asap' publishes it the moment generation finishes, with no scheduled time — do not set startAt or times.

startAt.description: When the publish slot may start: ISO datetime. Required unless mode is 'asap'. The slot must be 3h-30d ahead.

times.description: Daily publish times in HH:MM 24-hour format. Required unless mode is 'asap'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a naive startAt and the HH:MM times, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Defaults to UTC.

faceless.description: Generate faceless (no face). With a persona this drops only the face — the persona voice and niche still apply. Without a persona it is REQUIRED.

facelessMaterial.description: What fills the video, with or without a face: "broll" = real stock footage only, "svg" = drawn illustrations only. The two never mix. Defaults to "broll".

audioUrl.description: Public URL of custom audio for the videos (overrides the persona voice).

imageId.description: Library image ID to use for every video (overrides the deterministic per-video selection; see list_persona_images).

webhookUrl.description: Callback URL the server POSTs to when each video reaches a terminal state (completed/failed).

videoAspect.description: Frame shape. Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to 9:16.

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material (facelessMaterial: real clips or drawings). Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to "standard". Same render cost either way.

paragraphNumber.description: Paragraph count (1-10). Overrides the persona when one is given.

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US. Overrides the persona when one is given.

niche.description: Content niche. Overrides the persona when one is given.

options.description: Generation options applied to this video.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key: retrying the call with the same key returns the original schedule (replayed: true) instead of generating again.

tools.name: validate_script
tools.description: Validate a segments script mechanically, without spending tokens: hook first, CTA last, exactly one of each, no placeholders/links/markdown/emoji/stage directions, hook terminal punctuation, word limits (total 60-200, body at least 30, CTA 5-20, hook 15-40 words before TTS). Returns the word counts and the hook window (8-12 seconds spoken). Measured hook duration is pending a hook-only TTS endpoint and is reported as pending, never invented.

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, body in the middle, CTA last. Exactly one hook and one CTA.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

media.description: Phase 2: media reference, exactly one of mediaId (from upload_media) or url (a public image URL).

terms.description: Stock terms for this segment, chosen by the agent. At most 10.

segments.description: The complete script as segments to validate mechanically, without spending tokens.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload a local image for a video segment and get a mediaId to use in a segment's media field (generate_persona_video). The file is stored as a temporary engine asset (1 hour TTL, same flow as debug uploads): upload shortly before generating, since a scheduled slot far in the future may outlive the asset and the segment then renders without it. JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP only, max 8MB (the engine photo limit). The real content type is validated, not the extension. Returns only the mediaId — never a local path or asset URL.

path.description: Local image file path (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 8MB — the engine photo limit, not the 10MB library limit).

tools.name: check_media
tools.description: Mechanically check one public image URL for a segment, without an LLM and without judging relevance (the agent, who sees the image, decides relevance). Returns exactly one code: ok, blocked_403 (the host blocked the SSRF-safe download — retry with upload_media bytes fetched on your own machine), not_image, too_small, too_large, timeout, or face_detected. No fake User-Agent or Referer is sent to bypass hotlink blocks, and private addresses are never fetched. The URL never appears in the output.

url.description: Public image URL to check mechanically (no LLM, no relevance judgement).

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Check the generation status and fetch final video URLs for a taskId.

tools.name: get_video_task_progress
tools.description: Poll one video task for its machine-readable progress: returns {task_id, state, progress, stage, error}. error is the engine failure reason when state is -1 (failed), null otherwise. Use for the video after generate_persona_video; prefer this over get_video_status when only progress matters.

tools.name: list_persona_images
tools.description: List the image library of a persona (up to 10 tagged images). Each entry has id, tag, description, and is_primary. Use the ids with generate_persona_video options.imageId to force a specific image for the video.

personaId.description: The ID of the persona whose image library to list

tools.name: add_persona_image
tools.description: Add an image to a persona image library from a local file path (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB). Optional tag and description drive the deterministic per-video image selection. The server rejects full libraries (10 max).

personaId.description: The ID of the persona to add the image to

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (false is rejected — a new image is not primary unless marked)

tools.name: update_persona_image
tools.description: Update a persona library image tag, description, or primary flag.

id.description: The library image ID to update

tag.description: New tag (empty or whitespace-only clears the stored value; omit to keep it)

description.description: New description (empty or whitespace-only clears the stored value; omit to keep it)

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (the swap atomically demotes the old primary; false is rejected — mark another image instead)

tools.name: remove_persona_image
tools.description: Remove an image from a persona image library.

id.description: The library image ID to remove

tools.name: publish_video_direct
tools.description: Publish a ready-made video file directly to social accounts — no generation, no schedule. Reads a local video (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB) and posts it immediately via POST /api/upload-content. YouTube requires title, description, tags, and privacyStatus; Instagram/Bluesky/LinkedIn require caption.

provider.description: The social platform to publish the video to.

videoPath.description: Local path to the video file (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB). The video is published as-is: no generation, no schedule.

accountIds.description: Target accounts: the IDs from list_social_accounts (channel IDs for YouTube, IG user IDs for Instagram, DIDs for Bluesky, member IDs or org URNs for LinkedIn).

tags.description: YouTube only: required list of tags.
